svg.title: The retirement used above is an exact decomposition before it is an estimate. Keep one anchored listing for the whole input curve. For its full regular source write Afull(V ) = P j aj(V ). Partition its indices by the chosen retirement predicate and write aj = akeep j + atail j , including their original healthy masks. The same predicate is used throughout the compatible curve.
